whoosh.description: Airy medium whoosh for slides and pushes

whoosh-fast.description: Short bright whoosh for whip pans and quick cuts

whoosh-deep.description: Deep whoosh with sub for zoom-through transitions

swipe.description: Short bright swipe for wipes, iris and UI panels

reverse.description: Reverse swell that ends abruptly: lead-in to a slam or a hard cut

riser.description: Two-second tension riser (noise + rising tone), peaks at the end

impact.description: Cinematic low impact with sub drop and tail (logo hits, big reveals)

hit.description: Punchy short hit (text slams, counters landing)

click.description: Crisp UI click (buttons, cursor clicks, toggles)

tap.description: Soft UI tap (cards appearing, list items, hovers)

pop.description: Bubbly pop (badges, icons, notifications popping in)

tick.description: Tiny tick (counters, progress steps, typing on screen)

ding.description: Bright two-note success chime (done, sent, achievement)

type.description: Keyboard typing burst, 1.4 s (code / prompt typing)

glitch.description: Digital glitch burst (glitch transitions, errors, data)

shimmer.description: Sparkle / shimmer (magic moments, AI features, highlights)
